files.description: Complete EHI export documentation (3 pages). Describes export format (ADO XML recordsets + C-CDA R2.1), file naming conventions, directory structure, and VB6 code examples for reading exported data. Contains embedded screenshots of Windows Explorer showing export file structures. Updated 12/23/2025 for PCM Ver. 7.1.1877.

Rendered image of PDF page 1: General format notes, default export location, XMLDATAExport contents (CHART_DOCS, CHART_STORE, PATIENT, PT_ALLERGIES, PT_COMPLAINTS tables), and CDAXMLExport description. Includes embedded screenshots of file explorer showing ZIP contents.

Rendered image of PDF page 2: Chart document naming formats, patient data table naming conventions, and beginning of Section C (Data Export for Migrating to a Different EHR). Shows color-coded field naming examples and file explorer screenshots.
Rendered image of PDF page 3: VB6 code examples for saving and reloading ADO XML recordsets, next steps for migration, and support contact information.
